name: Ominaeshi Rail
source:
[i]"You wanna see my entire tattoo? Shall we get down and dirty, then?"[/i]

Ominaeshi was a police officer in the Public Security Bureau of the KANTO Home Ministry Police Affairs Bureau. He has the talent of not forgetting people's faces after seeing them once and is skilled at facial recognition investigations. He was born to a wealthy family, with Japanese and London Float parents. He is a party animal with wealth, talent, and beauty and always has fun with many women. He is a person who values friendship and is the one to always get angry first when his friends are harmed.
